notes.title: JRoguePG Closed Beta Application!

notes.title: Final freezing issue fixed!
notes.content: There was one final nagging freeze in Divided Reigns that is now 100% fixed. I have been playing for 20-30 hours over the last couple months and not a single freeze. Enjoy! :-)

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
After a lot of playtesting, we are pleased to announce Divided Reigns works perfectly with the Steam Deck... as long as you use Proton 7.0-6. Here is how to enable it on Steam Deck:

On the game screen, select the gear icon on the right.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/61519e1e6dc8335bb40d80f1a420353ca08f2f34.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/3ee209d189c49b5e6d2d80f365e0f4991f125c83.jpg[/img][/url]

Next go to Properties.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/f4ec2cce8b7e9822d57b1d65d0ee3c0192cfb075.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/13d6e63ba78d627ae1cfd628a9e2fa1e9d556f78.jpg[/img][/url]

Go down to Compatibility, turn on "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" and select Proton 7.0-6.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/46acde569b2b2df2e0e02614363958d5f2ed08a7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/4cee2f665fc0f196deabd7d306f3897d2ef16d48.jpg[/img][/url]

That's it!

I know this isn't ideal, but the issue seems to be with Proton compatibility and nw.js (basically the way the game is run), which is completely out of our hands. Hopefully they put out a new update for both so they behave together.

Happy Adventuring!

-Andrew

notes.title: 2 Years Old Price Change! Also minor update.
notes.content:
Divided Reigns is now 2 years old! To celebrate, it is now permanently $9.99! (If it still shows $14.99, it should change in the next 24 hours).

We just pushed a minor update addressing several bugs our players have found over the last few months. Thank you for everyone who posts bugs in the discussion board. We appreciate you so much!

Fairly major change: We disabled the "fps limiter" function because it seemed to be causing crashes for some players. This is the option to limit the fps to 60 to prevent the game from running too fast on faster hz monitors. However... I have a 144hz monitor and it still seems to run at 60 fps without this option. ¯\(º_o)/¯

Please let us know...
1. if your crashing has stopped, and
2. if you now have issues with the game running too fast. (You should be able to change your monitor's refresh rate to 60 if you need to... but that is a crappy fix)

The final change for this update is now the New Game + option to have the characters' classes swapped around should work correctly. It was 100% bugged before... which I found out live on stream. lol

As always, please review the game if you have the time. It helps us tremendously.

Thank you for 2 amazing years of playing, discussing, and enjoying Divided Reigns!
-Andrew

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
[h1]We plugged that hole![/h1]

The memory leak is OFFICIALLY plugged! You *should* not crash any more after extended periods of play. In order to do this, I had to do some deep code work, so please let us know if you find any bugs as a result. I can't playtest the whole game at the drop of a hat. ;-)

[h1]Automatic Fullscreen[/h1]

I don't have a Steam Deck to playtest on, but a friend of mine does! A special and genuine thank you to my best childhood friend CrispyPigParts for the help. DR works fine naturally with the Steam Deck except one thing: "Press F4 for fullscreen"........... you can't press F4 on the Steam Deck! To fix this, now DR just starts in fullscreen. Easy Peasy! I just saved you about .002 of a calorie by not having to reach up to  hit the F4 key every time you play. You're welcome.

Because of the above, now...

[h1]Steam Deck Supported![/h1]

I mean... it's just word of mouth and more play testing needs to be done, but it seems like DR works natively with the Steam Deck just fine. Yey! Valve did something right for once!

As always, please take a moment to write a review of our game if you have the time. It helps us tremendously.

Happy Adventuring!

-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: Memory Leak Fixed!!!
notes.content: Divided Reigns has had a bug since launch that we thought was unfixable. However, after receiving another negative review from the game crashing, we decided to do more research into the issue. We found a newly discovered possible fix and tested it and it seemed to work! Let us know if your game crashes after playing for a while, but.. *fingers crossed* we think it's fixed!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes, new accessory, some tweaked skills
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have been fixing more bugs over the last few weeks. This update addresses several  including the Gassy Giant bug, the Void Horror now (finally) working correctly, and others that were reported by the community. Thank you!

Some tweaks to skills: the strongest spells in the game have been buffed in power slightly. This includes, Conflagration, Upheaval, Nuke, Nuke Area, Astral Fury, Phoenix, Nidhoggr, Desecration, and Vitriolic Cascade. This should help magic users keep up in damage output a little better late game.

Also Masret's skill formerly known as True Strike is now called "Bolster Offense." A complaint some players had is there are too few ways to increase magic power during battle. Masret's skill now increases Attack and Magic by 20%. Enjoy!

In another attempt to address the issue described above, a new accessory has been introduced fairly early in the game in Wilton Woods called the Enhance Talisman. This accessory grants the wearer four new and unique skills which let you buff an ally's attack or magic. The single buff abilities are only 10 RP, and the double buff skills are 60 RP. Now anyone can be a support character! :-)

That is all for now. Thank you for reporting any bugs you find and for your feedback so we can make the game even better! As always, please take a moment to review the game. It helps us tremendously.

Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: Multitudinous Minor Changes
notes.content:
I'm finishing up a Very Hard difficulty playthrough and this update is fixing all the tiny issues I found along the way.

A few gameplay changes were made, but all were minor. Some abilities like Masret's True Strike now lasts 5 rounds instead of 3. Orson's traps last 5 rounds, are a little stronger, and remove other traps on the character so you can't pile them up. Shakar's Sneak Attack is slighly stronger.

Most of the changes were small graphical issues, spelling or other text-based mistakes, or tiny bug fixes.

There's a new enemy in the Vooresh sewers that appears pretty rarely, though you can't get back to that location once you've completed it.

The Void Horror around Virion's Castle is now possible to battle (oops). Go see if you can beat it and get the unique item it gives you!

Enjoy!

notes.title: One year anniversary of DR release!
notes.content:
[h1]One Year Anniversary![/h1]

It's hard to believe Divided Reigns is already one year old. To celebrate, we're permanently lowering the price to $14.99 USD. Thank you to everyone who's purchased our game, supported us, and written a review. We do this for you and we have been overwhelmed with your positive feedback.

We've started working on the first of nine new endgame quests--one for each main character. First up is Celeste! In her quest you will find out who won last year's fencing tournament, participate in this year's tournament, address the issues with Celeste's parents, and finally learn what those gem fragments are for!

[h1]Update Specifics[/h1]

A fairly minor update is live today. A special thanks to use Mechalibur and my father for finding and reporting several bugs and typos.

[list]
[*]Gall's world and battle sprites have been updated to more accurately represent Lunali's full-size art
[*]The two Mace weapons you get from monster hunts have had their attack and magic powers increased slightly
[*]The two Blade Staves have had their stats increased slightly
[*]Several minor typos and misspellings have been fixed
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get into Fort Abel way too early
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get to Fort Nynnyaw early
[*]Fixed the bug (again) with the Abeyan child in the Kairon capital saying the wrong thing
[*]Poe's Chest Quest achievements SHOULD work correctly now (let me know if they don't)
[*]The skill Rapid Attack now hits twice like it's supposed to
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get infinite green gems from the skills trainer
[*]Fixed a bug with Ailfred's Journal late game regarding liberated towns
[/list]

As always, thank you for playing our game! If you have a moment to write a review of Divided Reigns, we would appreciate it! It helps us greatly.

Happy adventuring!

-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: Expanded Ralts skills, New 100RP animation, rebalanced Sneak Attack, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]New Ralts weapon enchantment skills[/h1]

Ralts' weapon enchanting skills have never really worked how they were originally planned. They were supposed to increase base attack by 10% and make EVERY attack done with that character the element of choice. However, if the attack had a type to it, the type of attack overwrote the element attack.

Example: Ralts enchants Shakar's weapons with fire. Shakar does a weak attack... it's fire elemental! Yey. Shakar does a Sneak Attack. Since it has no attack type, it's fire elemental. Yey. However, if she does a side attack, reach attack, etc. all of those will NOT be fire elemental because the type of the attack takes precedence.

While this is still the case, to make up for it there are now 3 new skills that go with each elemental enchantment! They are as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/5f8a3c0e40ad4ec3aad6f3f8bbeed5270ec01dc8.png[/img]

20RP - <element> Attack - About as strong as a strong type attack but with a small chance to inflict the corresponding status effect for that element.
50RP - <element> Wave - A little stronger than the previous skill but it hits all enemies and has a slightly higher chance of inflicting the status effect.
80RP - <element> Onslaught - A massive single target attack of the element type with a high chance of inflicting the status effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/1a63eabd5980eb0616a4e398ab82beaa561f6624.png[/img]

[h1]Changed Accessories[/h1]
There are 8 items that have gone through a few changes during development that have been changed again. These are: Cape, Brigandine, Greaves, Crampons, Circlet, Bracers, Tunic, and Pauldrons. Previously they each gave different combinations of defense against two attack types and gave a little armor. Even though I'd tweaked them a few times, they were largely forgettable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/f26c0cce8de3b861036c99995e620b2b69af3010.png[/img]

Now four of these fulfill the original role. They are as follows:
Cape: -50% Ranged, M. Arts
Brigandine: -50% Thrust, Side
Greaves: -50% Low, Trip
Pauldrons:  -50% Reach, High

The other four have been changed to try to give the player more versatility in their equipment even earlier. Stats that you used to not have much control over (magic evasion, agility, max HP, and an extra weak attack) you can now tweak with this gear.

Crampons: Raise Agility
Circlet: +10% Magic Evasion
Bracers: +1 Extra Weak Attack
Tunic: Increases maximum HP

Hopefully this change makes these specific 8 items (and all their more powerful versions) more useful and give you, the player, more control over how you build your characters.

[h1]New 100RP High skill - Heaven Strike[/h1]
In our continued effort to give every 100RP attack type skill its own unique animation and functionality, we just completed the High skill Heaven Strike. You will smash down on the targeted enemy, then send out a shockwave hitting every enemy on the screen including the original target. Check it out the next time you need to bash a few heads!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/15b51e6f525a1ae89772591826f19a628adfb9bf.png[/img]

[h1]Shakar's Sneak Attack rebalance[/h1]
Shakar's sneak attack  has a large portion of its damage based on her physical evasion. This makes it a difficult skill to balance. Previously it worked fine for regular difficulty, but it was too weak on the easier difficulties and WAY too strong on the harder difficulties. It should be balanced well now for all difficulties. If you get her evasion very high, expect this skill to really decimate your enemies, but don't expect it to do much otherwise.

Lastly are a few bug fixes including the Ring of Aggression prompting an extra round of RP growth at the start of the battle for all allies for some reason. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ It's fixed now.

We've received many glowing reviews recently. We read every one and we want  you to know it means the world to us. We're so glad so many people are enjoying what we created.

Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: The Choicemaker's Tomb is open!
notes.content:
Our biggest update ever is here! The bonus endgame dungeon The Choicemaker's Tomb is now open!

[h1]Level cap increased to 120[/h1]
The level cap has been increased from 99 to 120. This will let you enjoy leveling up your party members in the new dungeon even if you were previously maxed.

One thing to note, if you had previously power-leveled and had more experience than the 99 cap allowed, your xp will be reset to 99 as soon as you go to the world map, the final dungeon, or into the Choicemaker's Tomb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/84117dd105cc19bfb8f4ae260f138b041b2f93da.png[/img]

[h1]The Choicemaker's Tomb[/h1]

As promised pre-launch, our first of two super hard endgame dungeons is now complete and open for you to explore. It is the biggest dungeon in the game (even bigger than the final dungeon). Expect to be pushed to your limits strategically in the battles and intellectually in the puzzles of the dungeon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/269356dc1f8fe045280bb268b1ea7f194fff0f3e.png[/img]

[h2]How to get there[/h2]

The quest that leads you to the Choicemaker's Tomb starts in the Knowledge Repository in Moloke very close to the end of the game. Speak with the woman in the middle of the second floor and she'll guide you to her home and tell you about the dungeon. Once you get back to the world map, you will find the tomb in a ring of mountains on the Hess-erabian continent accessible only via airship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/d7223fd32fc96565a7331c22b0ebf086de6d139e.png[/img]

[h2]Battles[/h2]

Battles are handled differently in The Choicemaker's Tomb. With the severely increased challenge of this dungeon, we didn't want you simply being able to run from every battle, or save and reload each time you stumbled across a specific enemies you don't want to fight.

There are no random battles! (Yey?) Now you trigger battles by stepping on purple battle traps. The battles are also sequential meaning you have to face and overcome each specific group of enemies in order to progress. However, there is a rare item you can find that will let you skip a battle and face the next set of enemies. This system also lets you try different parties and equipment set-ups to overcome each specific battle--something that is impossible with random battles. This lets us make the challenge of the battles even greater.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/9b6bf4168d17e1230417b82d095a976143817939.png[/img]

[h2]1v1 battle[/h2]

Previously in the game there was only one 1v1 battle. We always planned on doing more and there is a quite difficult one about halfway through this dungeon. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/20e4b697970ca22b6ac3f4b61b831a4f29700508.png[/img]

[h2]Three Team Dungeon[/h2]

In all the JRPGs I've ever played, my favorite final dungeon is Kefka's Tower from Final Fantasy VI. I always loved that you had three teams of different characters that had to work together to get through the dungeon. I also loved that you had to spread your equipment out across all your characters to try to make balanced teams. There's just a ton of strategy in that gameplay design... so I replicated it in the second half of the Choicemaker's Tomb. It's full of puzzles and difficult battles with only 3 characters in each team. You thought the battles were hard with 4 characters! >:) Also it's nice to see Ralts finally getting his chance to lead a team. :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/4e5b1197434b251109219a0919c0c4bf76aadb8d.png[/img]

[h2]Ties to Einlanzer[/h2]

The Choicemaker's Tomb update ties Divided Reigns' world to our previous game Einlanzer. It was hinted at by several things including the Choicemaker's churches. This update expands the lore drastically. There are also many homages to Einlanzer. In the tomb you will find tremendously powerful new gear that was once used by each of the 10 main characters from Einlanzer. If you've played both games, you'll certainly enjoy the tie-ins. If you didn't play Einlanzer, don't worry--you won't be confused or lost in any way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/1d9f143879bf0aa4e532d1ab6a1e559ee0c97a2f.png[/img]

[h1]Weapon Rebalance[/h1]

in my recent Hard mode playthrough, I started to notice an issue as the game went on. The issue is that the power of the weapon you chose to equip didn't seem to matter enough. If you wanted to have a lot of attack power, it was all in your accessories and other gear. I found myself either building glass cannons (all offense and almost no defense) or not attacking at all.

To fix this, [b]every weapon in the game has had its attack power increased by 20%![/b] This should make which weapon you choose to equip a much more impactful decision. Also, every accessory or other piece of gear that increases attack now grants slightly less (except the Power Ring). Those Strength Belts were too good before and you know it! :-P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/3efdabbc7810fd78bd94ac5adcc20b2e655c57f3.png[/img]

[h1]Enemy Defenses Rebalance[/h1]

Compounding the issue above, I also found in my playthrough that if you don't build glass cannon (all offense), you can do very little attack damage especially to heavily armored enemies. What's the point of equipping a tank to do some counter-attacking if those counter-attacks barely scratch the enemy? What's the point of attacking with a character if their attack damage is 10% of your main attacker's?

To address this issue...
1. All attack skills now calculate the enemy's defense to a slightly lower degree.
2. Each enemy that used to have a massive amount of armor now has less armor, but lowers all physical damage by a %.
3. Counter-attacks are slightly weaker now but calculate in about HALF the enemy's armor that they used to. Now you should never get a big ugly lame 0 damage from a counter-attack.

Simplified example:
[list]
[*]Previous: Armored Man used to have 300 armor.
[*]Attack for 800 damage and 500 damage gets through (not too bad because you built this character strong)
[*]Attack for 350 damage and only 50 damage gets through (not fun)

[*]Now: Armored Man has 150 armor but reduces all physical damage by 25%
[*]Attack for 800 damage and you end up dealing 488 damage (almost the same as before)
[*]Attack for 350 damage and you end up dealing 150 damage (the target is still tanky, but at least you can damage it without building super offensive)
[/list]
[h1]NPC Dialogues[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/bd63c942a69081b360a9f16f9b3660a79b188912.png[/img]

We have received many glowing reviews recently. Thank you SO much! We read every single one. In a couple, reviewers said they'd wished NPC dialogue changed more as the game progressed to reflect what was happening in the world. Now they do!

I wrote new dialogue for most of the NPCs in the entire game. Many have multiple dialogue changes as the story progresses. There are so many now that I doubt you could ever read them all. There are also a couple who reward you for heroic deeds.... ;-)

[h1]New Sadak-Reel Challenge[/h1]

While I was creating new NPC dialogues all across the game, I came across a building that was previously inaccessible in Sadak-Reel. Vooresh soldiers guarded it, but eventually they pull out. Previously they were just... still there. Now they're gone and the building is accessible! I wanted to do something fun and new with it. There is a very powerful and unique item hidden in there as well as a strange and powerful new enemy. Go check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/372ac713fa4364264d314b8351b38dcaddda8f6c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/d54d9d3965b3d2f87558991a180def8a4aaa5366.png[/img]


That's it for this update! We hope you enjoy The Choicemaker's Tomb! As always, please take a moment to review Divided Reigns. It helps us tremendously!

-Andrew Ryan Henke - Founder of Nostalgia Addict Games

notes.title: Bug fixes and small equipment rebalancing
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

This patch addresses bugs that have been brought up by the community. Thank you for everyone who reported bugs in the discussion board. Both my and Adam's personal lives have been very busy recently, so thank you for being patient with us getting around to fixing them.

[h1]Some specific bugs[/h1]
Many minor bugs and grammar mistakes are being fixed in this update, but here are some of the more notable ones.
- Before, the spells Phoenix and Nidhoggr would use the command "force action" to do the secondary effect of the spells. If your character had another action coming via Time Flux, Haste, etc., it would cancel the next actions. Now, the secondary action these spells cause happens at the end of the round. This does change the strategy with these spells a tiny bit.
- Dual Thrust now does both attacks like it's supposed to.
- Margaret in Kairon should now be gone as intended. Also, her son will actually take the Talents as expected.
- There is now a battle background if the Kairon mercenaries attack you on a small settlement tile.
- The kid you have to talk to in Zeben now stands still. Him walking around randomly was causing frustrating bugs for players who prefer to use the mouse to play.
- The accessory "Magic Evasion Pendant" now correctly gives the wearer 30% evasion.
- The 100RP skill Decapitating Swing now does the correct animation. (Go check it out!)
- New Game + modes "Element swap" and "Class swap" both should work correctly with the new difficulties Story and Very Hard modes.
- Unity weapons granted their element absorbing properties to whoever wielded them before. Now it's only the chosen character as intended.

- One bug that I could not chase down nor replicate is that the end credits roll then the final scene with Celeste and Shakar doesn't play. Let me know if this happens for you.

[h1]Minor equipment rebalancing[/h1]
- On the item Spirit Orb, the 75% MP usage was simply too strong. It is now 50%. The armor and magic resist debuffs were removed and the magic power was raised to compensate.
- Spiked shields now grant more attack power and the parrying blades grant less (Parrying blades were too good)
- Excalibur is slightly stronger now
- Buckler of Wounding now grants slightly more attack power
- Diamond Rod now grants slightly more magic power
- Monk Shoes now grant a little more attack power

[h1]Also...[/h1]
The secret human Talent shop in Moloke now sells Healing Breeze and Healing Gust potions. No one sold them before. Now you can optimize an Auto Healing Breeze user with some Pharmacology boosting equipment for a viable healing build on any character!

Lastly, the next update will feature the Choicemaker's Tomb bonus end-game dungeon. It'll take a few weeks to get it ready, but we are very excited to get it out to you. You'll really have to use your wits to beat these monsters. ;-)

As always, please take a moment to write a review of Divided Reigns. It helps us tremendously!

Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew Ryan Henke

notes.title: The Alchemist Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/b9d7abc174f88d820f7bf4aedb6e399717dde011.png[/img]

The next update is here bringing you new unique items, a skill animation, bug fixes, art, and more! Details below.


[h1]Auto Potion Accessories[/h1]
Let me introduce you to a new accessory type: the Auto Potion!

When you equip one of these accessories, if that character has less than 100% HP at the end of the round (or MP for the Auto Ether), the respective item is used automatically! Be careful of your item reserves, because these accessories can gobble up your items quite quickly if you don't have a large stockpile. These are potentially quite powerful accessories. Therefore, there are only one of each type in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/1242a9ddccfbf9da506c78ddc096d6f64d0a5bc1.png[/img]

There are five versions in all. All have been placed through the progression of the game and in a way that if you're past that area in the story, you can go back later and acquire each.
[list]
[*]Auto First Aid - Can be found [spoiler]on one of the dead ends in Wilton Woods.[/spoiler]
[*]Auto Potion - Can be found [spoiler]at the top of "Northernmost Point," the secret area just north of Vooresh castle accessible via ship or airship.[/spoiler]
[*]Auto Potent Potion - Can be found [spoiler]The eastern wing of Fort Nynnyaw.[/spoiler]
[*]Auto Ether - Can be found [spoiler]at the top of "Kairon Lookout," the secret area on the western side of Kairon accessible via ship or airship.[/spoiler]
[*]Auto Healing Breeze - Can be found [spoiler]on the northwest side of the poison swamp near Pon.[/spoiler]
[/list]
Auto Potion also works with items that increase your "Pharmacology" stat, so put on your Chemist Gloves, Pharmacology Gloves, or the new item described below to make your Auto Potion accessory even more effective!

[h1]Alchemist Robes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/d46a89737aefa0b4f27af4adffaf12ed17b13424.png[/img]

Purchasable in the Moloke Red Gem shop, the new Alchemist Robes give you further control over your item usage. The robes increase the wearer's "Pharmacology" stat by 50%, so most restorative items used by the character wearing the robes are increased by 50%. Stack this with your Chemist and/or Pharmacology Gloves to increase item potency even more! The Alchemist Robes are also quite defensive for a Robe, so they would be a great fit for the healer of your party.

[h1]New Battle Background Art[/h1]
Adam created two new beautiful battle backgrounds for the final dungeon. There is one for the metal/mechanical sections and one for the red caverns sections.

There's also a new scripted miniboss in the final dungeon to show off the new enemy the Automaton and the mechanical background. The red cavern background can be seen further down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/c4cc45761edd2ef3c86ac2514cb6e99990f06654.png[/img]

[h1]Redesigned Whirling Fury[/h1]

Continuing our process of redoing all the 100RP attack skills, next up was the Reach skill Whirling Fury. It has been completely redesigned! Now the skill hits more times the more enemies are on the screen. It will always hit the selected target enemy at least twice. If you happen to find a battle with the maximum enemy count of 8, your character will attack a whopping 12 times!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/3f0111a819ca3bd056aaf44713e4cc0d3ab1f725.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

A couple notable bugs have been fixed. The Poe achievements should work now and automatically be fixed by going to either world map. Also, the Very Hard mode achievement should work now when you beat the game on that difficulty.

Besides many small bug fixes (shoutout to Shadow Dragon for tons of help with bug screenshots), that is it for this update! If you have a moment, please write a review of Divided Reigns. It helps us tremendously!

Sincerely,
Andrew Ryan Henke



P.S. The next update should be the highly anticipated "Choicemaker's Tomb." This bonus super hard end-game dungeon will include tons of new items, enemies, story, and a maximum level increase of up to 120.

notes.title: Two new difficulties!
notes.content:
We've received several negative reviews now saying the game is too hard. This update aims to address these complaints by giving more options and control to the player over the difficulty of the game. Below are the specifics, but to summarize...
[list]
[*]Regular difficulty is now slightly easier (via slightly more HP, Defense, and Magic Defense)
[*]New "Story Mode" difficulty for people who just enjoy the story and don't want to worry about battles
[*]New "Very Hard" difficulty for people who want an even greater challenge than Hard offered (and a new accompanying Very Hard achievement)
[*]Chickens in every town to permanently lower your difficulty if desired.
[/list]
[h1]New Difficulty Selection Screen[/h1]

On a new game, you'll notice a snazzy new difficulty selection screen. I tried to summarize each difficulty mode in as simple of terms as possible without getting into the specifics and overwhelming a new player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/15782f166d4b82cbf33b30995031e7b29ca06043.png[/img]

[h1]Slightly Easier Regular and Easy Modes[/h1]
We've received a few negative reviews saying the game is too hard. In an effort to address these concerns, all characters have slightly more defenses on Regular difficulty. HP, Defense, and Magic Defense were all raised slightly to make fainting characters a little less common.

Also, on Easy difficulty, all characters now regenerate 5% HP and 2% MP in and out of battle.

[h1]New Difficulties[/h1]

[h2]Story Mode[/h2] Story Mode is designed to make the game less tedious and much easier for someone who wants to experience the story more than anything else. Story Mode takes the stats from Easy mode and makes these changes:
[olist]
[*]Significantly more HP for all characters
[*]All characters have a passive 10% HP regeneration and 5% MP regeneration. The goal here is so players don't have to heal after every battle.
[*]Half as many random battles
[*]Double the experience earned for each battle to make up for there being half as many.
[*]Easy achievement is still earned upon beating the game.
[/olist]
[h2]Very Hard Mode[/h2]
I (Andrew) like a challenging JRPG! Hard mode was originally designed to be very, very difficult. After release, many aspects of the game became more streamlined and a bit easier. Hard mode has become a little less hard (though it's still far from a walk in the park). To satisfy players like me who want a difficulty that really pushes the limits of your knowledge of the combat mechanics, Very Hard Mode won't disappoint.

Characters base stats were lowered from Regular difficulty to Hard difficulty. The base character stats are basically the same for Very Hard mode as they are for Hard mode HOWEVER the stat changes apply to equipment as well! This suggestion was made by unknown_zzz, so thanks to him for the idea!

Here is an example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/a8b32fcf0c544eed4548e08b6b8fdadd1ea8ce79.png[/img]
In the top two screenshots, you can see the difficulty is set to Hard mode. The equipment gives the full bonuses as expected. In the bottom two screenshots, the difficulty is set to Very Hard mode with the exact same equipment. The equipment bonuses are lessened to the same extent as the base stats. This solves one issue with Hard mode where the game gradually became easier the farther you got into the game because your equipment gets exponentially stronger and stronger. This is no longer the case for Very Hard mode.

There is a new achievement for Very Hard Mode! No one has the achievement as of posting this announcement. Could you be the first ever to achieve the Very Hard achievement?

[h1]Chickens/Lowering Difficulty[/h1]

There's one last major change with this update: the addition of chickens in every major town across the game except Moloke. Speaking with a chicken lets you have the option of chickening out ;-) to an easier difficulty. You can do this throughout the game up until very near the end of the story. Hopefully this addition will help players who underestimated the difficulty of Divided Reigns and can continue to play the same saved game without having to start over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/8048a3dd7fc201d605b5252c5689d68a23f6a1df.png[/img]

As always, if you have a moment please write a review of Divided Reigns. It helps us tremendously!

Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew

notes.title: Battle Stuttering Fixed!
notes.content:
This is a very small update mostly addressing one specific problem: hitching/stuttering in battle. After a lot of experimenting, I discovered the tumble effect that happens on the damage popup was causing the slowdown. It's sad because I really liked the tumbling damage, but it had to go.

A couple other small changes:
[list]
[*]For Gall's Ki abilities, the magic attack ratio is even higher now. Put some items on him that raise magic attack and see how powerful he gets! :-)
[*]Most HP Regen items and skills got a buff. They were useless before. Notably Regen Rings now add a little base HP and the regen effect was increased by 5% each. Also, Habar's Regeneration skill was increased from 10% each round to 20%!

That's it for today! Please take a moment to write a review of Divided Reigns. It helps tremendously!
Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew
[/list]

notes.title: New Animations, Rebalanced Attack Skills, Bug Fixes, And More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/ade2be8ec127386cbc23f6112de7b9d7f5d02470.png[/img]

It's now more than a month since Divided Reigns was released to the world and Adam and I couldn't be happier with the reception of our players. Thank you for joining us on this journey and we are so glad so many of you have had a great time with this game.

[h1]Some new content for you![/h1]
There's a new very difficult mini boss wandering around on the floating continent for you to battle! The Automaton hits like a truck and has three orbs circling it that each do unique things to influence the battle. This will also give your magic users a chance to shine since the Automaton has VERY high defense (an enemy type that was lacking in the final dungeon... people were just hacking and slashing everything to bits!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/082a4040d95dc8416322bffca6f0a11e0ce984c3.png[/img]

[h2]New Attack Animations![/h2]

We updated the 100RP Side attack "Decapitating Swing" in the last update. We have two more ultimate attack type skills completed for you! Check out a sneak peak of "Reckless Abandon" in the screenshot with the Automaton above, and the new "Bum Rush" (inspired by Sabin's Blitz from FFVI) in the screenshot below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/81382e30739ff44af41e11ecef3ec5862480cb86.png[/img]

[h1]Tons of tiny bug fixes and quality of life improvements![/h1]

There have been a lot of small bugs fixed that you'll probably never notice and are too numerous to list here. Special shoutout to unknown_zzz for sending me a spreadsheet list of over 300 bugs!

[*]Tiamat being broken after you lost to him one time was a major bug that took a lot of investigating to figure out what was wrong. Thank you for your patience with us fixing this. It should be good now! Let us know if you have any issues.

[*]People complained that Shakar's equipment was squished because "Weapon Offhand" was too long. Now it's just "Offhand" so her equipment has the same room to be read as the other characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/6461245bdac291d0a056d643fe72be0f2356199e.png[/img]

[*]Through the game, when you gain a new character, their level will automatically match either Ailfred's or another character in your party if Ailfred is taking a vacation when you gain that character.

[*]Reworked Ring of Aggression. This item was added near launch and it's never worked correctly. It was so OP it kindof broke the game. Now, it simply gives the wearer 50RP at the start of battle.

[*]Due to popular demand, the damage on end-game weapons has been increased slightly.

[h1]Rebalanced attack skills[/h1]

We had one reviewer say that the game is balanced poorly. I (Andrew) balanced and built all the numbers/stats/skills/enemies from the ground up. I put an incredible amount of effort and care into balancing the game, but there's always room for improvement. I always try my best to hear constructive criticism with an open mind.

I just rebalanced every physical damage ability in the game. 

I wanted to share with you the detailed specifics of how I crafted the skills in this game. While originally I used the concepts described below to create all the skills, magic, etc, through 4 years of development, numbers had been tweaked many times and the power of skills had gotten a little sloppy.

Click "Show Details" for the RP skill category list.
[expand type=details]0RP--(Dagger Flurry) (.5)
2+(a.atk*2)-b.def*1

0RP (Weak Attack) (.5)
5+(a.atk*2.5)-b.def*1.25

5RP (Type Attack) (.47)
15+(a.atk*4.3)-b.def*2

5RP (Master Type Attack) (.43)
25+(a.atk*4.6)-b.def*2

10RP (.46)
30+(a.atk*4.5)-b.def*2.07

15RP (Strong Attack) (.45)
45+(a.atk*5.5)-b.def*2.48

20RP (.44)
50+(a.atk*5.75)-b.def*2.53

25RP (.43)
55+(a.atk*6)-b.def*2.58

30RP (.42)
60+(a.atk*6.25)-b.def*2.63

35RP (.41)
65+(a.atk*6.5)-b.def*2.67

40RP (.40)
70+(a.atk*6.75)-b.def*2.7

45RP (.39)
75+(a.atk*7)-b.def*2.73

50RP (.38)
80+(a.atk*7.5)-b.def*2.85

55RP (.37)
90+(a.atk*7.75)-b.def*2.87

60RP (.36)
100+(a.atk*8)-b.def*2.88

65RP (.35)
110+(a.atk*8.25)-b.def*2.88

70RP (.34)
120+(a.atk*8.5)-b.def*2.88

75RP (.33)
130+(a.atk*9)-b.def*2.97

80RP (.32)
140+(a.atk*9.5)-b.def*3.04

85RP (.31)
150+(a.atk*10)-b.def*3.1

90RP (.30)
160+(a.atk*x11)-b.def*3.3

95RP (.29)
175+(a.atk*11.5)-b.def*3.34

100RP (.28)
200+(a.atk*12)-b.def*3.36

100RP+ (.27)
220+(a.atk*12.5)-b.def*3.37

100RP++ (.26)
250+(a.atk*13)-b.def*3.38[/expand]

[h2]What the heck am I looking at?[/h2]

This is the math behind every physical skill your characters use in the game. Let's take a look at one example:
[h3]30RP (.42)
60+(a.atk*6.25)-b.def*2.63[/h3]
[*]The first line "30RP (.42)" is the RP cost of the skill... in this case 30RP, and the ratio of attack user's against the foe's defense. Weaker attacks have a higher ratio of attack vs. defense. If you look down the list, weaker attacks have a much higher ratio than stronger attacks. In other words, the enemy's defense is factored in more heavily for weaker attacks than stronger attacks. The goal with this is to have weaker attacks always do some damage (especially with multi-attack skills in mind here) but have the obstacle of high defense enemies. However, if you just need to cut through a highly armored opponent, use a HUGE, single hit skill and it won't matter nearly as much.

[*]The second line in the example above works like this...
The first number is base damage (60 in the example). This in plain and simple a number added to an attack. Even early in the game, if you use a 90RP skill, you want it to do a significant amount of damage. That's the purpose of the first number. It becomes much less impactful through the game as you get more control to equip your characters how you want.

[*]The first parenthesis is the user's attack power multiplied with the number. In the example above, if Celeste has 100 attack, this part of the equation would equal 625 damage.

[*]After the - in the equation is the foe's defense which is subtracted from the first half of the equation. While higher damage skills do have a larger multiplier to the foe's defense, the ratio in the first line is consistent. Looking at the weakest skill (at the top of the list) "(a.atk*2)-b.def*1" is a ratio of attack to defense of .5 while looking at the last and strongest skill "(a.atk*13)-b.def*3.38" the foe's defense is higher, but at a much lower ratio of .26.

[*]More specifics. Power is increased or decreased if there are additional effects of the skill. If a skill has a positive effect like "50% chance of Internal Bleeding," then its power is lowered by one 5RP category. If a skill has a negative effect like "Goes last in the round," then it is increased by one 5RP category.

[*]Example, the Reach skill Jump is described as being very strong but goes last in the round. It costs 75RP. Without the drawback, it would be the 75RP attack power which is 130+(a.atk*9)-b.def*2.97. However, since it goes slow, I increased the power to the 80RP damage category, so it ends up being 140+(a.atk*9.5)-b.def*3.04. If a skill has multiple positive or negative effects (or a REALLY good effect like a chance at instant Faint) the damage might be increased or decreased 10RP or even 15RP categories.

[*]For skills with multiple hits like Shakar's Flurry of Death, I took the total RP cost (100 in this example) and divided it by how many attacks it has (4 in this example). Therefore, the damage for each attack in Flurry of Death WOULD be the 25RP category 55+(a.atk*6)-b.def*2.58. HOWEVER, each of those attacks has a VERY strong additional effect of 15% chance of instant Faint status. Therefore, those four attacks were lowered to the 15RP category and do 45+(a.atk*5.5)-b.def*2.48.

[*]One final caveat: Skills granted by equipping a weapon have a halved base damage (the first number). The reason for this is you have them at the start of the game if you equip that weapon. Doing 180 base damage with the 80RP Great Axe skill when you have 30 attack and are level 5... is a bit much. Also, I wanted the character skills and attack type skills that you learn and earn to be slightly stronger than the free weapon skills.

I hope you enjoyed that detailed look into the development and balancing of skills in the game. As always, please take a moment to write a review of Divided Reigns. It helps us tremendously!

Happy Adventuring!
[*]Andrew

notes.title: Late Game Major Offense Rebalance
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers!

There have been some very in-depth discussions on the DR Steam message boards about late-game balancing. The general consensus is that physical attacks are too strong and you can just steamroll almost every battle with "glass cannon" builds. Also, with such powerful equipment, the Hard difficulty stat changes became less and less drastic with the overpowered offensive equipment. This update aims to balance this through a few changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/dd7c2dc4cc5b270c899fe2b92f628a5063554e9a.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Power Ring and Arcane Ring now increase their respective stats by 25% instead of 33%
[*]The HP Ring is up to 33% like the other rings.
[*]Almost all late-game weapons have been nerfed slightly and rebalanced with each other (offhand weapons got a slight buff)
[*]Fixed bug where Celeste's "Distraction" skill worked 100% of the time even on bosses (shout out to player unknown_zzz for all his hard work with this one)
[*]All "Formation" skills are 40 RP and go before all regular skills without speed priority.
[*]Celeste's ultimate skill "Duelist Dance" now attacks three times instead of four. The power was buffed to compensate.
[/list]
We have also fixed several small bugs and a major one on Abel Wall that was blocking players' progress. One big notable bug that we haven't had the time to fix yet is the invisible Tiamat bug. Thank you for your patience with it. We will get to it soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/42392b033f48f94729cde0875957a29b85dc7968.png[/img]

For new content, we've wanted to have unique animations and character movement for the 100RP attack skills ever since launch. We plan on getting to all 8 of them eventually, but first up was the Side skill Decapitation Swing! Check it out in battle the next chance you get!

Thank you to all our players and their thorough discussion of strategy, balancing, and bug finding. We appreciate you so much and you are taking an active role in making DR a better game!

Happy Adventuring!

notes.title: Battle Stuttering Fix!
notes.content:
I (Andrew) did a deep dive and found some extra system files that weren't necessary and that were slowing down the game in a few ways. The most noticeable is in battles. The game now won't stutter when using spells/abilities that target a lot of enemies! This has been a huge sore spot since launch and was introduced when we were trying to figure out why achievements weren't working.

Some bug fixes and changes:
[list]
[*]The bug where you couldn't encounter Tiamat any more after he flees should be fixed (check to make sure and let us know, though).
[*]Celeste's ultimate ability Duelist Dance felt too similar to Shakar's ultimate ability Flurry of Death. Now, Duelist Dance does 3 attacks instead of 4 and damage has been increased to compensate.
[*]Finally fixed the orphan Abeyan bug where you could give him 1000 talents for eternity with nothing changing.
[*]Beating the game on Regular now gives you the Easy achievement too. Beating the game on Hard gives you Regular and Easy achievements.
[*]The power of level III spells was increased slightly.
[/list]

A few other small bugs were changed as well.

Let us know how the game runs for you or if you see any issues from this update.

Happy adventuring!

You spoke, we listened!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/fa5c126c1f31e7f1948f102b5de3576a71786256.png[/img]

notes.title: Auto Save Rework!
notes.content:
[h1]Auto Save Reworked[/h1]

Days before the launch of Divided Reigns, we had many streamers checking out the game. Though we'd already gone through a rigorous playtesting cycle for months, the streamers all had one major request: autosave!

We implemented the autosave feature 2 days before launch... and it's been a headache ever since. We have even received one negative review because of it. :-(

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/c5515bcdd5c8bb2efc1a01cf1c4ed40857478743.png[/img]

We have a new autosave feature! Now, the topmost save file will be reserved for the autosave feature. No more overwriting your current saved game!

One important note: If you were using the first save file slot (formerly file 1), BEFORE YOU DO ANYTHING ELSE, you will need to load that game and save to a new slot. We doubt this will be a problem for 99.9% of players, but we'd hate for anyone to lose their progress. A banner at the beginning of the game is there to make sure no one misses this and loses a save file.

A little more specifics on how the new autosave feature works: I manually placed every autosave to make sure it only happens at safe and optimal times. With a few exceptions, autosaves will happen generally in three places:
[olist]
[*]When entering either of the world maps
[*]When entering a town, dungeon, or other location from the world maps
[*]Moving between screens in any dungeon
[/olist]
[h1]Harder Hard Mode![/h1]

If you played Einlanzer (especially from launch) you know I (Andrew) like my RPGs hard. Probably too hard. The difficulty of both Einlanzer and now Divided Reigns has crept down steadily through development. Now, a few players on hard mode (and myself included) think hard mode is too easy. Now it's harder! Yey!

Former stat changes for hard mode were...
90% HP, MP, and Agility
75% Attack, Magic attack, Defense, and Magic Defense
-25 Luck

New stat changes for hard mode are...
75% HP, Defense, and Magic Defense
90% MP and Agility
67% Attack and Magic Attack
-25 Luck

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/62b8e8d7ab0b4dee88bd75193a3d21fb701b8138.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

As usual, there are too many bug fixes to list here (thank you again to everyone reporting them in our discussion board) but here are a few major bugs that we've now fixed.
[list]
[*]All 9 towns are now working properly for liberation.
[*]Corrected the "Low Attacks" skill name listed when learning Tumble. "Low Stance" doesn't exist.
[*]Previously, you essentially could no longer use your ship after you got the airship. It was landlocked outside the sonic temple cave entrance. Now, after you have both ship and airship, whenever you sleep at any town inn, the ship will teleport to the closest ocean spot to that town!
[*]Max level is back down to 99. It was too buggy and messed up balancing late game.
[*]Monster hunters no longer shapeshift into each other when turning in bounties.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! If you have a moment, please write a review of Divided Reigns! It helps us tremendously!

Happy Adventuring!
-Andrew

notes.title: Working F12 Screenshots, More Optimization, and Increased Max Level!
notes.content:
New small update is live! You may now press F12 for screenshots as intended! Post your favorite moments, a MASSIVE critical hit, or your favorite equipment loadouts to the Steam screenshots page!

We increased the maximum level to 199. The upcoming extra hard end-of-game dungeons will be designed for around level 99, and level 150 respectively, so don't go grind for 1000 hours in preparation.

We also further increased battle screen optimization. You should see even less hitching, better frame rate, and less clunky all around.

Lastly, we added more faces for King Ferrin. It's a small thing, but it's been bugging me ever since launch.

That's it! As always, if you could take a moment and review the game, it helps is tremendously.

Happy Adventuring!

notes.title: Bug fixes, balancing, optimization!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

This patch fixes many small and medium sized bugs that have been reported by you. Thank you for reporting what you find so we can fix it and make the game a more enjoyable experience for everyone

The biggest issue with the last update was hitching in battles when you hit multiple enemies as well as a memory leak. We're still looking into the memory leak, but the hitching should be MUCH better now. I exported every battle image file in the most efficient way. All image files are now between 10% to 50% smaller in file size, so everything should run way smoother. Let us know your experience with this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/99ecb9dbc2825c783f03b088f2c9ee4f0f7bb855.png[/img]

A small amount of new content. Every weapon trainer across the game now has a sign out front showing which weapons they train you in. Also, a new item has been added for purchase in [spoiler]Unity in the Moloke Red Gem shop. It's a nifty little buckler that makes your attacks inflict Internal Bleeding. Might be good on a certain rich girl or for someone who counter-attacks.[/spoiler]

Some balancing was trying to make magic a bit more usable late game. Our players who've finished the game all were finding the best offense builds only used physical attacks. Now, all magic is powerful skewed toward more powerful spells. Fire I is about 5% more powerful, but Fire III is about 15% more powerful. Vitriolic Cascade... well... you just have to try it for yourself. ;-) We also increased the MP you get from certain items and lowered the RP generation you get from all accessories. We also added two Mythril Mage Rings in [spoiler]Unity. One is able to be found in a house in Pon, and the other is near the end of the Crystal Mines.[/spoiler]

There are too many bug fixes to list here, but a big one was the monster hunt issue. People were getting weird results from trying to cancel old bounties and getting the wrong rewards. If you've experienced this, canceling any bounty should reset all the bugs.

notes.title: Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Some players are getting to the end of the game now which is really exciting for us! Also, many bugs have been discovered especially later in the game. Thank you to everyone who reported bugs as they find them! It helps so much!

Pretty much every bug that's been reported has been fixed, but here are some of the big ones.
[list]
[*]The sandstorm temple encounter rate was bugged and WAY too high and had a couple other bugs. It's fixed now. (Sorry to everyone who slogged through it before the fix)
[*]Fixed end game town liberation not being able to access each town
[*]Fixed several bugs with the monster hunts, but I'm afraid we didn't catch them all. Let us know if you find anything wonky with them.
[*]2H now on graphic for all bows
[*]Tweaked sonic temple singing bowl sounds to sound a little more clear
[*]Added option to turn on audio help in sonic temple after the initial prompt (just interact with the book again)
[*]Fixed many "doppleganger" bugs where characters who shouldn't be there were.
[*]Added the physical skills trainer to Gilgamesh's school in Moloke
[*]SO many more!
[/list]

Also, a little additional content, I added a couple new items you can buy from the red gem shop in Moloke. A really good bow called a Yumi, and an accessory that makes MP usage all the way down to 25%. There's a drawback though. ;-)

Thank you everyone for being such a supportive group! As always, if you have a moment, please take a moment to review the game when you feel ready. It helps us tremendously!

Happy adventuring!
-Andrew

notes.title: What's Next for Divided Reigns
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/dd55676677763a70cf9f477e781e45db14088f2c.jpg[/img]
To everyone who's purchased and reviewed Divided Reigns so far, we want to thank you! Every sale and heartfelt review means the world to us! It really does!

[h2]Working Achievements[/h2]
It's been a huge sore spot that our achievements haven't been working correctly. That is now fixed! Visiting the world map will grant you any achievements you have previously earned.

Huge shout out to the developer of Killer Gin which you can find here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164480/Killer_Gin/
In a moment where they could have been competitive and said, "lol, sux to be u" to us, they instead took the high road and helped us get our achievements working. If you haven't already, we highly encourage you to go check out Killer Gin, another recent great RPG maker game on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/29cfb3b111abc405eafb6e568f388a08ac746730.png[/img]
[h1]Big update![/h1]
[olist]
[*]Achievements are now working!
[*]Customizable keyboard controls (Go to the options menu
[*]Fixed fullscreen/windowed modes
[*]TONS of bug fixes
[/olist]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/548de3f2832689e762b929d631cb4eb6624851a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/3b8bcf1e11c2db9f88d79e27a809762d18f7a7e7.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/5029623886bd97221a6e264fb1686a3a223f569d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/a60aeb52f489e1ad16c19329479437626e51bc8d.png[/img][/url]

IMPORTANT:
Due to massive changes being made in the file structure of the game, you will have to copy and paste your save files. This image will guide you through the very simple process. We're a small two-man development team and we appreciate your patience with this inconvenience. This process will never have to be repeated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/f7ace0fb518729adff07d95af65cfb115c80cf3f.png[/img]
If you'd rather read the steps than look at the image, do these steps.
[olist]
[*]Open your Steam library (the games)
[*]Right click on Divided Reigns.
[*]Click Properties.
[*]Click Local Files.
[*]Click Browse.
[*]Open the folder called "save"
[*]Copy everything inside (press ctrl+a then ctrl+c)
[*]Navigate back one step to the main folder again.
[*]Open the folder called "www"
[*]Open the folder called "save"
[*]Paste everything in this folder (press ctrl+v)
[*]That's it!
[/olist]

[h1]What's next for Divided Reigns[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36986402/dd051ab336b1936a4de9c40eda331669e136f035.png[/img]

We have a lot of content we are planning, but up first is our two (yes two) huge, extra hard end-game dungeons! We are planning on release of these dungeons sometime summer 2021.

Also, our first regular seasonal event will be Halloween. All seasonal events, additional content, dlc, etc. will ALWAYS be free. No microtransactions EVER!


If you are enjoying Divided Reigns, please take a moment to review it. It helps us tremendously!

Thank you and enjoy!
Happy Adventuring!

-Andrew Ryan Henke
-Adam Dover

notes.title: New release date for Divided Reigns!
notes.content:
As gamers ourselves, Adam and I hate when release dates are announced, then aren't adhered to. Unfortunately, we have to push back the release date of Divided Reigns to April 2, 2021. It has been a crazy year with many unforeseeable difficulties in our personal lives that have slowed development. 

We've been steadily marching forward with development and polishing the game to an even higher level than we initially projected. We have the first 90% of the game 100% polished and we are very excited to release it to the world. However, the final 10% still needs to be completed, and being the epic conclusion to a game the player has put 50+ hours into, it simply needs to be fantastic.

The story is epic.
The characters are complex and relatable.
The battle mechanics feel familiar while having many new and completely unique mechanics.

We can't wait to bring you Divided Reigns on April 2, 2021.

Sincerely,
Andrew Ryan Henke
-Founder of Nostalgia Addict Games
